title: Concept: Pipfile source skips certificate verification
description: Pipfile declares a source with `verify_ssl = false`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Any host able to answer on the path is accepted as the index, so an interception looks exactly like the real source.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Pipfile (pypi).
risk: Any host able to answer on the path is accepted as the index, so an interception looks exactly like the real source.
